prompt:
Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2. Vanilla Minecraft blocks only, crisp voxel style, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side: LEFT straight-on front elevation, orthographic; RIGHT three-quarter view at the same scale. Show the whole site in each view. Skilled human builder quality: real massing and depth, proud details, recessed and framed openings, convincing flat-roof edges and parapets with coping and eaves, sub-block stairs, slabs, iron bars, trapdoors and lanterns. This is a buildable block construction, not smooth real-world architecture.

Site: modern roadside gas station on a flat 42x38 lot, front facing a two-lane black_concrete asphalt street with yellow_concrete dashed centre line and pale smooth_stone sidewalk with two wide curb cuts. Dark matte black_concrete forecourt. Across its front floats a large flat canopy, 29 blocks wide, 12 deep, about 3 blocks thick, top height 9 blocks. Bright white_concrete fascia with one continuous red_concrete stripe around it. Small block-built red-and-white brand roundel proud of centre street side. Underside smooth_quartz with a grid of glowing sea_lantern blocks. Four slim smooth_quartz columns on two raised polished_andesite grey pump islands. Each island has two grey fuel pumps with dark screens, lever hoses, plus yellow_concrete bollards at both ends.

Behind forecourt, single-storey flat-roof convenience store in two volumes, 7–9 blocks high. Left: white_concrete shop, full-height light_blue_stained_glass_pane storefront divided by black_concrete mullions, central double glass-looking doors using iron_door and adjacent panes, thin smooth_quartz_slab cantilever awning. Above awning red_concrete fascia with block-built white_concrete letters exactly 'MART'. Right: taller gray_concrete service block, narrow recessed gray_stained_glass_pane slot window, red_concrete logo square, rooftop iron_block HVAC units with iron_trapdoor grilles behind parapet. Both roofs smooth_stone_slab coping and thin iron_bars rail. Black_concrete plinth along store base. Ice chest and caged propane rack in front of grey block, assembled from iron_block, iron_trapdoor, iron_bars and cauldron.

East (right) grass verge: 13-block-high price pylon, red_concrete head with white block roundel, black_concrete price board in white_concrete frame, block-built white prices. Grass verges and birch trees both sides. Three parking stalls with white_concrete lines and EV chargers on west (left). Grey dumpster enclosure and air/water station on east. Flowering azalea hedge along back. No vehicles. Maintain identical construction and object counts between views.

Exact block palette by role (use these ids; do not depict a palette legend):
white: white_concrete, smooth_quartz, smooth_quartz_slab, smooth_quartz_stairs
grey: gray_concrete, gray_concrete_slab, gray_concrete_stairs, gray_concrete_powder
red: red_concrete
black: black_concrete
stone: smooth_stone, smooth_stone_slab, polished_andesite, polished_andesite_slab, polished_andesite_stairs
glass: light_blue_stained_glass_pane, gray_stained_glass_pane, white_stained_glass_pane
doors: iron_door, iron_trapdoor, iron_bars
light: sea_lantern, lantern, end_rod
road_paint: yellow_concrete, white_concrete
fittings: iron_block, lever, hopper, dispenser, cauldron, barrel, chest, hay_block, iron_chain, stone_button, stone_pressure_plate, light_gray_concrete, flower_pot
ground: grass_block, coarse_dirt, short_grass, dandelion
plants: birch_log, birch_leaves, azalea_leaves, flowering_azalea

Only vanilla block geometry and textures; no smooth curved signs, no custom furniture or non-block hoses. Clear readable architecture with soft daylight and restrained shadows. Two views evenly spaced on the light background.
changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and copied unchanged to concept.png.
Block identities are visual interpretations of raster concept art, not a verified Minecraft block inventory; inferred additions are identified in objects.

The supplied gray_concrete_slab and gray_concrete_stairs are not vanilla block ids. They were retained verbatim in the prompt but excluded from roles; real grey slab/stair options already present are polished_andesite_slab and polished_andesite_stairs.
The picture adds apparent gravel roof surfacing, grey wall-shaped enclosure posts, green dumpsters, blue lettering, wooden interior shelves, white flowers, and flowering leaf blocks.

Some fittings and text use custom miniature geometry: pump displays and hoses, propane cylinders, ice-chest lettering, price digits, AIR lettering, thin yellow bollards, and white MART letters are not faithfully restricted to vanilla block shapes.
The canopy gains a perimeter rooftop rail and textured roof surface absent from the site description.
Only two substantial canopy columns are clearly represented, rather than four slim columns.
Four fuel pumps appear in the three-quarter view, but their number and arrangement are less clear in the front view.
Two EV chargers are visible; three parking stalls are clearer in the front view than in the three-quarter view.
The three-quarter view adds a second eastern dumpster enclosure and utility station, creating inconsistent object counts between views.
The service-block slot window is vertical rather than a narrow horizontal slot.
The storefront has opaque iron double doors rather than double glass doors.
The logo becomes a stepped white ring or cross-like emblem on a red square rather than a clearly circular roundel.
Flowering landscaping extends across the storefront and around the verges instead of being concentrated along the back.
The left view shows roof undersides and ground depth, so it is not a strict straight-on orthographic elevation. The two views do not maintain a demonstrably identical scale.
The 42x38 lot, 29x12 canopy, three-block canopy thickness, and specified heights cannot be verified from the image.
Several retained plan blocks are not clearly visible: white_stained_glass_pane, end_rod, hopper, dispenser, cauldron, barrel, chest, hay_block, iron_chain, stone_pressure_plate, and flower_pot.
